title: The stairwell
logline: The stairwell of the Seattle building, invented: three flights, a window at each landing, the water smaller at each one going down. The page is read top to bottom like the stairs. No door opens.

panels.composition: An apartment stairwell drawn top to bottom in one page: three landings, a window at each with a smaller slice of gray water as the stairs descend, a mailbox bank at the bottom, no one.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, an apartment building's stairwell drawn top to bottom with three landings each with a window showing a smaller slice of gray water descending, a bank of mailboxes at the bottom, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Read like the stairs. No door opens.
